notes.title: 🧳✨ Announcing our new cozy game: Suitcase Stories!
notes.content:
Hello everyone 💙

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40614223/f5ac3f96843b2fbb0229902fd745fc72f85b0909.gif[/img]

We’re thrilled to finally reveal our next cozy project: Suitcase Stories!
It’s a contemplative game about packing life’s moments into suitcases — from childhood to adulthood.

This project began as a personal pause from the chaos of everyday life, and over the years it grew into something special: a quiet space to reflect, slow down, and find meaning in small moments.



🌿 Suitcase Stories is now live on Steam — and your wishlist helps us more than anything!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3974110/Suitcase_Stories/



Thank you so much for supporting our little studio and joining us on this heartfelt journey. 💚

⸻

✨ And if you’d like to stay even closer to us, join 400+ cozy game lovers in our monthly newsletter:
https://creativehand.beehiiv.com/subscribe

🕹️ Creative Hand Cozy Newsletter – free updates, behind-the-scenes, cozy highlights, and tiny surprises delivered straight to you.

notes.title: Taking a moment to highlight a big inspiration for Tiny Witch
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40614223/0cc7674977d2247acfffc87976438d2d333a2a3e.png[/img]

Hello guys,

I am Ramon, the developer of Tiny Witch, and I bring news for you.
Firstly, thank you very much to all of you who have played, left your ideas, and reported any bugs you found. ❤️ We have seen your feedback and gameplay videos, and we are updating Tiny Witch based on them.

I wanted to take today to highlight one of my biggest inspirations for Tiny Witch today. I am greatly inspired by the women in my life, and my wife in particular is a huge inspiration and source of support. Her courage and strength in everyday life motivates me as we work to finish Tiny Witch. I have shared more details about the inspirations for Tiny Witch in this video here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=08k2-wlJIuE][/url] [b][i](Remember to turn on captions for your language)[/i][/b] 🙂

We are working hard to create a fun and engaging gaming experience. Currently, we are focused on including new accessories, features, and all the little touches that will make the game something special, so that each player can enjoy a unique and captivating experience.

[b][i](Caution! Spoiler below)[/i][/b] 😉


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40614223/ea4116f89f028108fcbb97e9b63abb826d42b12b.gif[/img]


We are grateful for your support and enthusiasm, and we are excited to share even more news with you. In addition to posting frequently here and on our social media channels, our Newsletter is another great way to stay informed about everything we are doing. If you’d like to keep up with the latest on Tiny Witch, be sure to subscribe to it!

[i][b]Subscribe:[/b][/i] [url=https://newsletter.creativehand.com.br/][/url]


Thank you so much for your support of our game. We will bring you more news soon!

Cheers,
Ramon


(P.S. If you haven't already, please add the game to your Wishlist – it makes a big difference for the small indies striving for visibility in the midst of all the amazing games that arrive on Steam every day!)

notes.title: IS BRAZIL THE NEW HOME OF INDIE GAMING?
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40614223/c4a259bdb3c75fec8cabbcb46a60cda5fec8b470.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! 

We are very proud to announce that this week is Brasil Game Maker Week. 

And our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1740310/Tiny_Witch/]Tiny Witch[/url] is found in this list. 🥳🎉 🥳🎉

We are very happy to see that the engine we have been using for years is recognizing one of our games.

💜💚


Taking the subject to do about Tiny Witch, we have collected all the feedback from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1740310/discussions/]community[/url] tab and are working on top of these improvements. 

We want to make the best game possible for everyone to enjoy, just remembering that we are a small studio with few people so new updates may take a while, but we are taking care of this as carefully as possible.

If you want to send us a message, don't hesitate to call us on [url=http://discord.gg/aaFwfht]Discord[/url].

I hope everyone has a great week.

Best regards,
Creative Hand Team

notes.title: The turkey is coming.
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
After a few months we can finally announce our new game. 

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be in a turkey's worst nightmare? Or having to hide in a barrel to survive? And run away from cute kids? 

We ask because: There Will Be No Turkey This Christmas, it will be our next game.

Experience the worst Christmas Eve ever, after all, you are the turkey.


Add to your wishlist

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639040/There_Will_Be_No_Turkey_This_Christmas/

If you want to know more about the behind the scenes and how the game is developing, join our community.

Join the Discord:  http://discord.gg/aaFwfht
